question: During depletion, the oil phase volume fell from 60.19 mL at 29 MPa to 41.35 mL at 20 MPa. By what percentage did it shrink?
rendered:
The oil phase volume fell from 60.19 mL to 41.35 mL. 

To find the percentage decrease: 
(60.19 - 41.35) / 60.19 = 18.84 / 60.19 ≈ 0.313 or 31.3%
